name: Kanzen Bad End
source:
When I woke up, I was in an unfamiliar room.
There's a rope around my ankle.
The young man in front of me tells me.
That I'm his 'fiancée'...

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/6685]Freem![/url]]
